items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: They called me and asked me to do it at the last minute... We had fun there.

ctx.x: George Wein They called me and asked me to do it at the last minute, but I couldn't do it because I was working in Japan on July 4th. (They were there until the 7th or 8th I guess it was?) and then they came back out. We had fun there.
I was so tickled when you said you came back with .......
